name: Confetti Button
description: Tilting 3D button with a party cannon icon that fires a burst of colorful confetti particles when clicked, with three color variants.
contents: Single button with a party cannon icon and a text label
behavior: Button tilts in 3D toward the cursor and resets on mouse leave
Click fires confetti particles from the cannon with a GSAP animation, then the cannon bounces back with an elastic ease
Cannon streamers retract and confetti pieces vanish during the click animation
editableByProps: Button, text, shadow and cannon colors in the dark variant
Confetti colors, amount of particles and streamer stroke width

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the confetti launch angle, speed or fall distance
needsCodeEdit.where: generateParticles function and the generateParticles call in handleExplicitClick

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
White and grey variants use fixed built-in colors that ignore the color props

options.look: Dark navy button with light text, driven by the color props
options.useWhen: Confirm or submit action on a light page where the button should stand out

options.look: White button with a thin outline, dark text and blue cannon
options.useWhen: Secondary action on a tinted or colored section background

options.look: Muted grey-blue button with white text and light cannon
options.useWhen: Subtle confirm action in a dark-toned or neutral UI
